topic: Built experiment (promoted from a Tier-2 repo seed): Hs reads EUV lithography as a composition -- the stochastic valley-of-death as a {OK, missing, bridge} defect composition; the LPP source as a laser+droplet+plasma budget; dose/CD as a deformation field.

specific_knowledge.what: EUV at 13.5 nm (~91.8 eV/photon): photons per feature are Poisson (photon shot noise). Public imec two-sided stochastic cliff: under-dose -> missing/broken contacts; over-dose -> bridging/merging. So the per-feature outcome is a composition {OK, missing, bridge}; a slow dose drift shifts the ratios before total defectivity crosses the yield spec. The LPP source (CO2/2um drive laser + tin droplets at ~100 kHz, ~5% conversion efficiency, >250W) is a laser+plasma composition whose stability/coherence is yield-limiting.
key_points: Measured (euv_stochastic_drift.py, 877516b6): under a 1.000->0.975 dose drift over a 100-wafer lot, Hs flags the silent ratio drift at wafer 7 (defectivity ~0.006 ppm, ~18x under spec) vs single-channel yield alarm at wafer 69 = 62-wafer lead; arrow = missing/broken -> steer dose UP.
The two-sided cliff makes the arrow a DIRECTIONAL helmsman (missing->dose up, bridge->dose down); a scalar total-defect count is direction-blind (rises on both sides of the valley).

Source common-mode: a drive-laser pulse-energy droop is a shared multiplicative factor on dose across fields -> closure rejects it exactly; the coherence law suppression_dB ~ -10log10(1-rho) applies (coherence_demo.py a5ceab9e); Hs reads source coherence back and gates on it.

Honest fences: physics-grounded Poisson model is illustrative (T2); real resists add CHEMICAL stochastics on top; lead time is spec/drift-dependent (durable claim is qualitative: ratio leads the count); model numbers not fab numbers.
